scope: Fresh complete 14-job execution07 from the original fixed inputs, with explicit GitHub artifact barriers. Unchanged original science and numerical resource contract; no old stage import. Initial execution-ready compatibility field does not replace target runtime/source/capacity/asset admission.

durable_execution.runtime_qualification_scope: Fresh measurements in the actual finite 8GiB Docker destination, never inherited host receipts.
durable_execution.prior_runs: Preserved separately as historical costs/evidence; no prior output supplies a current scientific job.

concurrency.memory_measurement: cgroup v2 memory.current/memory.max/memory.stat; do not count all slab_reclaimable as available.
concurrency.pending_growth_formula: sum(max(0, registered_worker_reservation - live_process_VmRSS)) over ACTIVE_WORKERS.json; nonexistent PIDs contribute zero.
concurrency.admission_rule: effective_current + pending_growth + new_worker_reservation + 1 GiB margin <= cgroup memory.max; workers wait for their PID to appear in ACTIVE_WORKERS before importing scientific runtime.
concurrency.payload_rule: effective_current + pending_growth + rounded_new_file_allocation + 1 GiB margin <= memory.max, as well as filesystem and logical-byte checks, inside the shared write lock.

resource_qualification.after_successful_family_completion: max(512 MiB, ceil((1.25 * maximum_completed_family_VmHWM) / 64 MiB) * 64 MiB)
resource_qualification.eligibility: Completed jobs only, positive recorded process high-water mark, same declared legacy family. Pure memory/completion metadata only; no score or effect qualification.

concurrency.groups: Controller enforces declared phase dependencies and group compatibility. W/finalization are exclusive. R may use two registered slots but is not mixed with other scientific writer groups.
concurrency.oom_events: Record baseline counters before admission. On increment, stop new admission, preserve/record the event and let existing workers reach guarded persistence boundaries; do not silently retry affected work.

readiness_flag_scope: The inherited execution_ready field is an original API declaration only. It is not destination capacity, runtime, asset, durability, lifecycle, or scientific admission evidence.

restart.kind: All fourteen prescribed jobs execute fresh; no previous stage is imported.
unchanged: all sample sizes and paired seeds
observers, estimands, margins, bootstrap and multiplicity rules
restart.outcome_selection: No outcome is used to select this operational plan.

proposed_resource_contract.raw_storage_kind: Disk-backed task-owned raw and CAS roots in the registered Docker destination.
proposed_resource_contract.persistence_scope: Per-stage independent GitHub artifact readback and ACK are required before advancement; no successful delivery or current capacity is claimed by this static document.
proposed_resource_contract.numeric_legacy_scope: The original numeric core resource policy is unchanged. external_raw_uploads=0 describes the original core; the new independently measured supervisor transport has seventeen required archives plus terminal closure.
proposed_resource_contract.current_capacity_scope: Only actual execution07 destination capacity/runtime receipts establish current measurements. Historical capacity samples are not copied here.
